title: Family Christmas Clipart, Christmas Png
author: Dillus Studio
description:
Family Christmas clipart. This set includes 7 (png) watercolor elements from which you can assemble an image of a family to create a personalized gift. Illustrations are perfect for printing on logos, postcards, posters, fabrics and dishes. It is possible to create personalized sublimation.
The size of the downloaded images is 12*12 inches
